title: 1965 AHSME Problem 17
statement: Given the true statement: The picnic on Sunday will not be held only if the weather is not fair. We can then conclude that:

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text:
If the picnic is held, Sunday’s weather is undoubtedly
fair.

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text:
If the picnic is not held, Sunday’s weather is possibly
unfair.

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text: If it is not fair Sunday, the picnic will not be held.

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: If it is fair Sunday, the picnic may be held.

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text:
If it is fair Sunday, the picnic will be
held.

solutions.text:
The statement says: if the picnic is not held, then the weather is not fair. Its contrapositive is: if the weather is fair, then the picnic will be held.

Therefore, the correct answer is E.
hints: Take the contrapositive of “not held implies not fair”
